tagline: Leading self-storage operator in the United States with over 3,100 facilities
hero_kpi_rationale: Net operating income is a key indicator of the company's financial health in the real estate sector, reflecting the ability to generate revenue after direct operating costs.

kpis.name: Net Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Net income generated from operating activities
kpis.description: Net operating income is a key indicator of the company's financial health.
kpis.signal: Decline in net operating income in 2025

kpis.name: Same-Store Net Operating Income Change
kpis.explanation: Change in net income generated by the same stores compared to the prior year
kpis.description: The $15.3 million decline in same-store net operating income reflects pricing pressure on rental rates for new tenants and a decrease in average occupancy in 2025.
kpis.signal: Decline in same-store net operating income in 2025

kpis.name: Net Operating Income from Non-Same Stores
kpis.explanation: Net income generated by non-comparable stores and newly developed facilities
kpis.description: The $68.4 million increase in net operating income is primarily driven by the impact of facilities acquired in 2025 and 2024.
kpis.signal: Increase in non-same-store net operating income in 2025

kpis.name: Same-Store Operating Expenses Change
kpis.explanation: Change in expenses related to the operation of comparable stores
kpis.description: The 1.8% increase, or $16.6 million, in operating expenses is primarily due to higher property tax expenses and indirect operating costs.

kpis.name: Acquisition Volume Since 2023
kpis.explanation: Total value of facilities acquired since the beginning of 2023
kpis.description: Since the beginning of 2023, the company has acquired 273 facilities with 19.9 million rentable square feet for $3.9 billion.
kpis.signal: Significant investments in facility acquisitions since 2023

kpis.name: Net Operating Income 2025
kpis.explanation: Net income generated from operating activities in 2025
kpis.description: Net operating income is a key indicator of the company's financial health.
kpis.signal: Decline in net operating income in 2025
